items.description: A trader makes quote-only LP positions reject stock withdrawals; production reachability remains unverified because the repository defers Wrapped LP.
proof: Admitted W/Q, W=currency0, fee=0, tickSpacing=60, tick=0, sufficient quota, valid SBT and issuer permissions.
Opening [-120,-60] with L=1e18 produces W debt zero and Q debt 2986382804598882.
A stock exact-input swap of 1e17 with min Q output 1 crosses the range, consumes 3013380206076240 W, and returns 2986382804598881 Q.
Closing produces 3013380206076239 W credit; PermissionsAdapter burns transferred W and sends U, leaving the owner W balance unchanged.
TSVDirectSettlementLib.takeTo requires recipient W increase equal to amount, so the enclosing removal reverts SettlementMismatch.
Stock inputs also fail because PermissionsAdapter rejects W transferFrom sources other than PM.
